paragraphs: A Class I recall of Imperio Fuego Beef Jerky poses a serious safety risk [1]. The 2 oz. sealed bags were produced without inspection and have been distributed in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, and Wisconsin [1]. Consumers should not eat this product [1].

HAIFA SMOKED FISH is recalling Cold Smoked Sprats due to potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum, a bacterium that can cause life-threatening illness [4]. Consumers are warned not to use the product even if it does not look or smell spoiled [4]. Approximately 560 lbs. were affected [4].

Taylor Farms is recalling H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kits due to undeclared soy and almonds [3]. People with sensitivity or allergy to these ingredients may face serious adverse reactions [3]. SLR Food Distribution Inc. is recalling Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon because it potentially contains elevated levels of lead [2].

The FDA has declared an end to an outbreak linked to Trader Joe's chicken wraps, though a new outbreak is under investigation [9]. Five children in San Luis Obispo County, California, have been infected with Shiga toxin-producing E. coli following visits to Brookshire Farms between October 16 and 26 [17].
